title: cursor fetch_usage_events
description: One billed model call: the raw Cursor event object from POST /teams/filtered-usage-events, stored verbatim. The connector reads only timestamp, conversationId and userEmail; every other key is the vendor's.

timestamp.description: When the call was billed, as epoch milliseconds encoded as a decimal string (not a number). The connector skips an event whose value does not parse as a positive integer.

conversationId.description: The conversation the call belonged to. Never empty: an event without it is skipped.

userEmail.description: The developer's email. Copied to metadata user_email; empty or absent on some events.

model.description: Vendor field. Mixes internal model identifiers with display names.

kind.description: Vendor field. A human-readable label such as "Example plan", not a stable code.

tokenUsage.description: Vendor field. Token breakdown; absent on a small fraction of events.

chargedCents.description: Vendor field. Amount charged in US cents, fractional.

serviceAccountId.description: Vendor field. Arrives as the literal string "null" when there is no service account, not as JSON null.
